messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['IT Helpdesk has introduced the Alert System to manage and minimize the risk of COVID-19.', 'Most likely your computer was infected by a recent virus and now runs a hidden proxy server.', 'As well as checking email coming in from outside the University we will also be checking emails sent from within the University.', 'Your Microsoft Windows Installation record is out of date.', "You've replaced Your 1 Month Subscription with a 6-month subscription", 'Our system detected unusual charges to a credit card linked to your account.', 'If you plan to use this account in the future, you have to download and launch the latest update for the AIM.', 'IT Security immediately Password Reset', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Our Technical Unit is performing a scheduled Digital Banking software upgrade', 'This message is from Technology Assistance Center.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
